senses.gloss:
यह यह, अस्, m. or यहस्, अस्, n., Ved.
water; strength, power.

यहु यहु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. = महत्, great;
(उस्), m. = अपत्य, offspring, a child, (in Ṛg-veda
VIII. 60, 13, Agni is called सहसो यहुः, Sāy. =
सहसः पुत्रः.)

यह्व, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. = महत्, great, mighty,
powerful, &c.; (perhaps) being in continual motion
or activity, restless, active; continual, perpetual (said
of Agni, Rudra, and Soma); continually moving or
flowing; (व्यस्), f. pl., Ved. flowing or running
water, a river, (सप्त यह्वीः, the seven great rivers);
(वी), f. du. epithet of heaven and earth, of night
and day, of evening and morning, (according to
Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 142, 7, यह्वी means ‘the two
children,’ according to some it may mean ‘the two
hands’); (अस्), m. = यजमान, a sacrificer (accord-
ing to Uṇādi-s. 1. 154).

यह्वत् (fem. अती), Ved. = यह्व above; (accord-
ing to Sāy. यह्वती = महती, great.)
